selectedTask.title: Concurrent Owner-Clone Parity Coordinator - Public, Authentication, and Seeker
selectedTask.goal: Coordinate three non-overlapping parity lanes against the owner-controlled Figma clone, preserve frontend_099 as the honest Public closure history, and converge Public, Authentication/Onboarding, and Seeker screens with independently verified evidence.
notes: This is the single audited coordinator task for exactly three concurrent lanes: public_parity, auth_parity, and seeker_parity.
frontend_099 remains Partial and retains its Public PUB-01 through PUB-08 history; this task does not falsify or replace that status.
Canonical source is FIGMA_FILE_KEY=Odl1Epn2u6lIEuIMmABT7o. The source key 0HBdTNGROmmpC6S7OYa3iJ is forbidden.
Lane ledgers are maintained under docs/quality/figma_parity/PUBLIC_LANE_LEDGER.json, AUTH_LANE_LEDGER.json, and SEEKER_LANE_LEDGER.json.
Arabic RTL and English LTR are the only execution locales. Simplified Chinese is not added or tested.
Public and Auth cover Desktop, Tablet, and Mobile. Seeker covers Desktop only.
No nested subagents, branch, or worktree is permitted.
acceptance: Maintain exactly one In Progress coordinator task and three non-overlapping lane ledgers.
Process every canonical Public, Auth, and Seeker screen in its assigned lane using the approved Figma source and cached evidence; do not skip screens or invent supplementary screens.
Resolve exact clone node, route, role, permissions, locale, direction, device, deterministic state, API projection, and prototype flow for every lane screen.
Implement repository-owned defects in the owning lane or coordinator-owned shared/backend path; return exact change requests for cross-lane shared changes.
Capture after real repairs with ready fonts, decoded images, stable animation state, exact viewport, and reviewed numerical and visual diffs.
Close screens only as REPAIRED_VERIFIED or VERIFIED_NO_CHANGE; keep PARTIAL only for a genuine documented external blocker.
Run focused functional, API, accessibility, security, locale/direction, device, visual, and performance checks during lane work; defer the full matrix until convergence.
Do not claim Public, Auth, Seeker, or platform parity while required evidence, normal snapshots, or repository-owned material differences remain.
verification: lane-specific typecheck, lint, unit, integration, API, accessibility, permission, and security tests
focused per-screen approved-source visual comparison and reviewed diff
normal visual snapshots without --ignore-snapshots after direct clone review
synchronized lane ledgers and coordinator checkpoint
combined final gates only after all three lanes converge
